------------------------------------------------------------- Command Object Structure (Blueprint) ------------------------------------------------------------- This defines the standard object structure we will use to store the outcome of executing each command.

[PSCustomObject]@{ OriginalIndex = $index # Integer: 1-based index from the original CSV ListName = $listName # String: Name of the command list CommandString = $commandString # String: The actual command executed CustomName = $customName # String: User-defined name or CommandString RuntimeIndex = 1 # Integer: Which iteration this is (for future -Repeat feature, defaults to 1) Status = 'NotRun' | 'Success' | 'Failure' | 'Skipped' # String: Execution outcome StartTime = $null # DateTime: When execution started EndTime = $null # DateTime: When execution finished Duration = $null # TimeSpan: Total execution time Output = $null # String[] or String: Captured StdOut/StdErr ErrorRecord = $null # System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord: Error details if Status='Failure' ExecutedInParallel = $false # Boolean: Whether it ran via ForEach-Object -Parallel } -------------------------------------------------------------
